name: pwm_adc
description: hardware_pwm: slice 0 at 1 kHz (125 MHz / 125 / 1000) on GP16 (25 %, then 75 %) and GP17 (75 %), its wrap interrupt once a period (ms counts from boot, wraps from pwm_set_enabled: the set-up between them at the Cortex-M0+'s cycle costs puts the 520th wrap just after the 520 ms line). hardware_adc: ADC2 on GP28's 1.0 V source (floor(1.0 * 4096 / 3.3) = 1241), the temperature sensor's 0.706 V (876), ADC0 on GP16's PWM through a 10 kOhm, 4.7 uF low-pass (0.8 and 2.5 V to 0.1 V); then 50 ms of free-running conversions at 1 kHz (DIV 47999), round robin over ADC0 and ADC2, through the FIFO and its interrupt.

expect.contains:
fifo: 50 conversions, last rc=2.5V adc2=1241
done
